original: No sign of the Hydra yet... but a remarkable large number of Acid Grenadiers once again. Physical similarities between the two species exist, but perhaps there is a stronger biological link than we expected?
translation: Гідри поки не видно... зате знову напрочуд багато кислотних гренадерів. Ці два види мають фізичну схожість, але, можливо, їхній біологічний зв'язок тісніший, ніж ми думали?

original: The waves have ceased, yet the Hydra remains absent... I'll be in my lab... re-evaluating the data to determine why the Emitter failed to do its job. Do not disturb me.
translation: Хвилі припинилися, але гідра так і не з'явилася... Я буду в лабораторії... переглядати дані й з'ясовувати, чому випромінювач не виконав свого завдання. Не турбуйте мене.

original: You did a great job, Commander. While Kraus is busy with his R&D, you and I can meet for R&R.
translation: Чудова робота, командире. Поки Краус зайнятий дослідженнями й розробками, ми з вами можемо зайнятися відпочинком і розвагами.

original: Do not lose the Pheromone Emitter
Clear the Bug infestation in the Mining Tunnel
translation: Зачистіть зараження жуками в шахтарському тунелі

original: Welcome back, Commander. The situation here is... well, it's a bloodbath.
translation: З поверненням, командире. Тутешня ситуація... Що ж, це справжня бійня.

original: The local miners got careless, dug their tunnels into a Hive, and now the whole town got turned into Bug territory.
translation: Місцеві шахтарі втратили пильність, прокопали тунелі до вулика, і тепер усе місто стало територією жуків.

original: I need you to hold this outpost, clear that Hive, smash every Bug you encounter and remind the Arachnids that every inch of this rock is human territory!
translation: Утримайте цей аванпост, зачистіть вулик, розчавіть усіх жуків на шляху й нагадайте арахнідам: кожен сантиметр цієї скелі — людська територія!

original: You're almost at the tunnel. Alas, no survivors in the town... It's a total loss.
translation: Ви майже біля тунелю. На жаль, у місті ніхто не вижив... Його повністю втрачено.

original: Heads up, Commander! Massive signatures are bearing down on the outpost.
translation: Увага, командире! До аванпосту стрімко наближаються численні цілі.

original: I've already got dropships moving your squads back to the perimeter.
translation: Я вже відправив десантні транспортники повернути ваші загони до периметра.

original: Get down there and defend the position like you mean it, Commander. I'll be watching the show!
translation: Спускайтеся туди й захищайте позицію як слід, командире. А я подивлюся виставу!

original: I'd trust you to hold my borders any day of the week, Commander. See you back at base!
translation: Я будь-коли довірив би вам захист своїх кордонів, командире. Побачимося на базі!

original: Unlock Snipers in the Technology Screen
Spitters are present in your sector. You should request access to Sniper squads to counter this threat.
translation: У вашому секторі виявлено плювачів. Запросіть доступ до загонів снайперів, щоб протидіяти цій загрозі.

original: You can acquire additional technologies through the technology panel.
translation: Додаткові технології можна отримати на панелі технологій.

original: Commander, secure territory points and HQ will reward you with more resources.
translation: Командире, захопіть територіальні точки, і штаб надасть вам більше ресурсів.

original: Good progress on capturing territory points. Capturing and holding these positions is essential to assure success in current and future missions.
translation: Захоплення територіальних точок просувається добре. Захоплюйте й утримуйте ці позиції — це запорука успіху в нинішніх і майбутніх місіях.

original: Your territorial expansion is impressive, commander. Feel free to secure more points, or shift your focus to other objectives.
translation: Ваше розширення території вражає, командире. Можете захопити ще кілька точок або зосередитися на інших цілях.

original: You are running low on supply. To support more units, you can deploy a supply depot on one of your delivery platforms.
translation: Вам бракує постачання. Щоб підтримувати більше юнітів, розгорніть склад припасів на одній із платформ доставки.

original: Well done, additional supplies are now available. You can deploy more units.
translation: Чудово, тепер доступне додаткове постачання. Можете розгорнути більше юнітів.

original: You are running low on supply. To support more units, you can deploy a supply depot on one of your delivery platforms.
translation: Вам бракує постачання. Щоб підтримувати більше юнітів, розгорніть склад припасів на одній із платформ доставки.

original: Well done, additional supplies are now available. You can deploy more units.
translation: Чудово, тепер доступне додаткове постачання. Можете розгорнути більше юнітів.

original: Place a dropsite near the crashed dropship
translation: Розмістіть зону висадки біля розбитого десантного транспортника

original: A sandstorm just swatted a dropship right out of the sky - deep in Bug territory. Word is, one of our top Generals was on board, and HQ wants to know if he's still breathing.
translation: Піщана буря щойно збила десантний транспортник углибині території жуків. Кажуть, на борту був один із наших провідних генералів, і штаб хоче знати, чи він іще дихає.

original: It's a mess out there, but I know you can handle a little heat. Go find our VIP.
translation: Там справжнє пекло, але трохи жару вам не завадить. Знайдіть нашого VIP.

original: Dropship's clear, but bad news for the General. The survivors say he was incapacitated during a Bug attack and got dragged off toward the nearby Hive.
translation: Транспортник зачищено, але щодо генерала погані новини. Уцілілі кажуть, під час нападу жуків він знепритомнів, і його потягли до сусіднього вулика.

original: We cannot allow the Arachnids to 'pick his brain'--literally. Find him, and get him out - or make sure there's nothing left for the Bugs to extract.
translation: Не можна дозволити арахнідам буквально «покопирсатися в його мізках». Знайдіть і витягніть його — або подбайте, щоб жукам не лишилося чого з нього витягати.

original: Fresh blood on the sand, Commander. It's human. The target is in that Hive--get moving.
translation: Свіжа кров на піску, командире. Людська. Ціль у тому вулику — ворушіться.

original: VIP is off the ground. Nice work, Commander!
translation: VIP уже в повітрі. Чудова робота, командире!

original: Massive signatures are closing in on your position...
translation: Величезні сигнатури наближаються до ваших позицій...

original: Hold the line--we want you back home in one piece!
translation: Тримайте рубіж — ми хочемо повернути вас додому цілими!

original: You never cease to impress, Commander. Once you've got the blood and sand out of your cracks, meet me for debrief.
translation: Ви не перестаєте дивувати, командире. Витрусіть кров і пісок з усіх щілин та приходьте на розбір.

original: Place a drop zone near the crashed dropship
translation: Розмістіть зону висадки біля розбитого транспортника

original: Rescue the General from the Hive
Unlock Engineers in the Technology Screen
Unlock Radio Operator in the Technology Screen
Watch your step, Commander. There's a lot of ground movement--Drones, and plenty of 'em. I'd suggest bringing in some Combat Engineers.
translation: Дивіться під ноги, командире. На землі повно руху — трутні, і їх чимало. Раджу викликати бойових інженерів.

original: You'll need a radio operator to extract the civilians.
translation: Для евакуації цивільних вам знадобиться радист.

original: Defeat the Tanker in the Hydro Plant
We've got a crisis at the hydro-plant, Commander. Comm-chatter mentioned a Tanker breaching the defenses from below, breaking the perimeter from the inside, but I can't confirm that yet.
translation: На гідроелектростанції криза, командире. У радіоперемовинах згадували танкера, який прорвав оборону знизу й розірвав периметр ізсередини, але підтвердження ще немає.

original: Regardless, Bugs keep pouring into the facility. Set up your defenses and halt the incursion.
translation: Хай там як, жуки сунуть на об'єкт. Зведіть оборону й зупиніть вторгнення.

original: You'll need more Materiel for those Turrets, Commander. Deploy a Materiel Depot to increase your stockpiles.
translation: Для цих турелей потрібно більше матеріальних засобів, командире. Розгорніть їхній склад, щоб збільшити запаси.

original: The defense is holding. Still zero evidence of a Tanker breach on my scans, though. Sweep the plant and get that control station back online.
translation: Оборона тримається. Але на сканерах досі жодних ознак прориву танкера. Прочешіть станцію та відновіть роботу станції керування.

original: I've got a distress signal from some civilians huddled up in that settlement. Get a Radio Operator on-site to coordinate a dropship evacuation.
translation: Надійшов сигнал лиха від цивільних, що сховалися в тому поселенні. Відправте туди радиста для координації евакуації транспортником.

original: You'll need a radio operator to extract the civilians.
translation: Для евакуації цивільних вам знадобиться радист.

original: I stand corrected! The Tanker is very real and it's right on top of you. Put it back in the dirt, Commander!
translation: Беру свої слова назад! Танкер справжній і вже просто над вами. Закопайте його назад у землю, командире!

original: Standard rounds aren't going to cut it. Equip your troopers with grenades if you want to crack that Tanker's armor!
translation: Звичайні набої тут не зарадять. Озбройте бійців гранатами, щоб пробити броню танкера!

original: Efficient - and not afraid to get your hands dirty! Head back to base, Commander - you've earned yourself a hot shower.
translation: Ефективно — і руки забруднити не боїтеся! Повертайтеся на базу, командире. Ви заслужили гарячий душ.

original: Unlock Radio Operator in Technology Panel
Swap a Supply Depot for a Materiel Depot
translation: Замініть склад припасів на склад матеріальних засобів

original: Unlock Grenades in the Technology Panel
We recommend completing the Ground Pounders tutorial missions first.\n\nDo you want to switch to the Ground Pounders Battlegroup?
translation: Радимо спершу пройти навчальні місії бойової групи «Топтуни».\n\nПерейти до бойової групи «Топтуни»?

original: In Territory Mode, you can only load saves from the current mission.\nTo load a story campaign saved game, return to the main menu.
translation: У режимі територій можна завантажувати збереження лише поточної місії.\nЩоб завантажити збереження сюжетної кампанії, поверніться до головного меню.

original: This bar displays the Arachnid threat level. This steadily grows over time.\nMake sure you don't fall behind by capturing and holding Territory Points at a steady pace.
translation: Ця шкала показує рівень загрози арахнідів, який невпинно зростає.\nНе відставайте: регулярно захоплюйте й утримуйте територіальні точки.

original:
This campaign uses Territory Mode game mechanics:
  • Capture Territory Points to gain Resources 
  • Units and reinforcements cost Resources
  • Research Technologies to unlock unit types and upgrades
translation:
Ця кампанія використовує механіки режиму територій:
  • Захоплюйте територіальні точки, щоб отримувати ресурси 
  • Юніти й поповнення коштують ресурсів
  • Досліджуйте технології, щоб відкривати типи юнітів і вдосконалення

original: Terran Command wants us to regain control over the Dam in this sector.
translation: Terran Command наказує відновити контроль над дамбою в цьому секторі.

original: The base is secure! Good job commander.
A major victory for regional security! We have successfully seized a vital radio station in this sector.
translation: Велика перемога заради безпеки регіону! Ми успішно захопили життєво важливу радіостанцію в цьому секторі.

original: The Bugs made ugly work here. The Federation wants the atrocities documented. We're here to film the slaughter.
translation: Жуки вчинили тут жахливу бійню. Федерація хоче задокументувати ці звірства. Ми тут, щоб зняти наслідки.

original: Approaching a massacre site. Cameras ready.
translation: Наближаємося до місця різанини. Камери напоготові.

original: Closing on another site. Get it on record.
translation: Наближаємося до іншого місця. Зафіксуйте все.

original: Footage secured. Move to the next site.
translation: Матеріал відзнято. Рушайте до наступного місця.
Ще одне місце відзнято. Рухайтеся далі.

original: Recording complete. Proceed to the next objective.
translation: Зйомку завершено. Переходьте до наступного завдання.

original: All scenes documented. The galaxy will see what happened here.
translation: Усі місця задокументовано. Галактика побачить, що тут сталося.

original: Cameras are limited. Lose too many and we can't complete the mission.
translation: Камер обмаль. Втратимо забагато — не виконаємо завдання.

original: All recording crews lost. Mission cannot continue.
translation: Усі знімальні групи втрачено. Місію продовжити неможливо.

original: In a tragic act of retribution, the Federation has collected our fallen soldiers and delivered justice to the bugs.
translation: У трагічному акті відплати Федерація забрала наших полеглих бійців і відплатила жукам по справедливості.

original: Some civilians have painted graffiti in this sector. We're here to remove it all.
translation: Цивільні розмалювали цей сектор графіті. Ми тут, щоб усе стерти.

original: Approaching a graffiti painting. Get your firefighters ready.
Closing on another graffiti. Get it cleaned.
translation: Попереду ще одне графіті. Зітріть його.

original: Graffiti removed. Move to the next.

translation: Ще одне графіті стерто. Рухайтеся далі.

original: Graffiti removal complete. Proceed to the next objective.
translation: Усі графіті тут стерто. Переходьте до наступного завдання.

original: Firefighters are limited. Lose too many and we can't complete the mission.
translation: Пожежників обмаль. Втратимо забагато — не виконаємо завдання.

original: All firefighters are lost. Mission cannot continue.
translation: Усіх пожежників втрачено. Місію продовжити неможливо.

original: Mobile Infantry patrols have erased anti-Federation graffiti, restoring pride and unity to the sector.
translation: Патрулі Мобільної піхоти стерли антифедераційні графіті, повернувши сектору гордість і єдність.

original: Several facilities caught fire after a surprise Arachnid incursion. Extinguish them.
translation: Після раптового нападу арахнідів загорілося кілька об'єктів. Загасіть їх.

original: Approaching a burning facility. Keep the firefighters close.
translation: Наближаємося до палаючого об'єкта. Тримайте пожежників поруч.

original: More fires ahead of your position, Commander. You know what to do.
translation: Попереду ще пожежі, командире. Ви знаєте, що робити.

original: Hephaestar is asking why the last facility is still burning. Get it under control.
translation: Гефестар питає, чому останній об'єкт досі горить. Візьміть ситуацію під контроль.

original: One facility secured, Commander. Move to the next.
translation: Один об'єкт убезпечено, командире. Рушайте до наступного.

original: Another facility secured. Updating Hephaestar on your progress.
translation: Ще один об'єкт убезпечено. Доповідаємо Гефестару про ваш поступ.

original: All fires extinguished. Hephaestar commends your actions, Commander.
translation: Усі пожежі згашено. Гефестар високо оцінює ваші дії, командире.

original: New firefighter squad deployed. Keep them alive. If we run out, we can't complete the mission.
translation: Новий загін пожежників розгорнуто. Збережіть їх. Якщо вони скінчаться, місію не виконати.

original: Hephaestar is out of firefighter crews. Mission cannot continue.
translation: У Гефестару не залишилося пожежних бригад. Місію продовжити неможливо.

original: What could have been a disaster has been averted. The Federation has successfully extinguished a series of raging fires.
translation: Можливу катастрофу відвернено. Федерація успішно приборкала низку лютих пожеж.

original: Clear graffiti with the Cleaning Crew unit
Do not lose more than {0} {1} units
context: ExtinguishObjectiveLines; {0} and {1} will be replaced {0} is a number indicating the amount of units {1} is the unit name

original: A major threat has been neutralized today! Thanks to the heroic efforts of the Federation.
translation: Сьогодні серйозну загрозу знешкоджено! І все завдяки героїчним зусиллям Федерації.

original: Our troopers have successfully eliminated an infestation from key facilities in this territory.
translation: Наші бійці успішно очистили ключові об'єкти на цій території від зараження.

original: Royal Guards detected in this sector. Kill them all!
translation: У цьому секторі виявлено королівських вартових. Знищте всіх!

original: Immolators detected in this sector. Kill them all!
translation: У цьому секторі виявлено спалювачів. Знищте всіх!

original: Ravagers detected in this sector. Kill them all!
translation: У цьому секторі виявлено спустошувачів. Знищте всіх!

original: Scorpions detected in this sector. Kill them all!
translation: У цьому секторі виявлено скорпіонів. Знищте всіх!

original: Hornet Tankers detected in this sector. Kill them all!
translation: У цьому секторі виявлено танкерів-шершнів. Знищте всіх!

original: Today's operation focused on the neutralization of a great Arachnid threat. The result: Another major victory for the Federation.
translation: Сьогоднішня операція мала на меті знешкодити серйозну загрозу арахнідів. Результат: ще одна велика перемога Федерації.

original: The Power Turbines must be repaired.
Thanks to the liberation of the surrounding territory, the power turbine can safely be rebooted without interference from the Bugs.
Vibrations from the power turbine reboot sequence are enraging nearby Arachnids. Our troopers will have to defend the machine until it's running smoothly again.
The Arachnid hordes heading toward the turbine have been wiped out by our brave troopers. Power output has been restored.
The power turbine has taken severe damage during an Arachnid attack of unexpected intensity. Our technicians will have to fix the damage and restart the machine.
Meanwhile, the enraged Bug horde continues its stampede toward our main base in the sector.
The Bug horde has finally been eliminated. Our technicians will now have to fix the damage and restart the power turbine.
Power has been restored to the sector following the heroic efforts of our armed forces.
With local power turbines restored, industry and defenses in this sector are back at full strength.
Our bases are fully powered again as our troopers have successfully restored power in this sector
Area secure. Bring the pumps online.
Activation triggered seismic activity. It's drawing Bugs from across the sector. Defend the station.
Primary conduit ruptured. Pumps offline and taking damage. Technicians must patch and restart.
Pumps down. The swarm is heading for the main base.
Swarm eliminated, but the pump station took a beating. Technicians must repair before restart.
Under the protection of The Federation, important pumps have been restored and are fully functional again.
Readings are off the charts. Technicians are moving in to activate the prospector.
Prospector activated. The vibrations are attracting nearby Arachnids. Protect the rig until the soil extraction is completed.
Soil extraction complete. Geological data secured.
The Prospector took critical damage and must be repaired.
The enraged horde is heading for the main base!
Swarm broken, but the prospector took heavy damage. It must be repaired before the soil extraction can proceed.
Important geological data has been secured by the Federation. This will certainly help us in our war against the bugs!
Bring the damaged Engineering Biped to the Main Base
Our troopers recovered important industrial equipment today.
A damaged Engineering Biped got stuck in hostile territory. It must be retrieved.
The Mech got destroyed! Repair it immediately!
Alright let's get this Mech Engineer to the base!
Attack wave is coming for the mech engineer!
Bring the damaged M9C Eradicators to the Main Base
A damaged M9C Eradicator got stuck in hostile territory. It must be retrieved.
The Marauder got destroyed! Repair it immediately!
Alright let's get this Marauder to the base!
Attack wave is coming for the marauder!
Several dropships have crashed in this region. It's our job to bring the pilots back to base.
We lost one of the pilots!
We have found a pilot! Let's bring him back to base.
We have rescued a pilot! Great job.
All pilots have been retrieved! Good job troopers!
The Federation leaves no one behind! Today, several downed pilots have been rescued from behind enemy lines.
One of the labs was under heavy attacks in this sector, some of the scientists have evacuated but we need you to bring them back home
One of the scientists is dead!
You found one of the scientists!
You have rescued a scientist, good job!
All scientists have been retrieved! Good job troopers!
The missing scientists have been retrieved! A succesfull mission for our troopers.
Mercenary camps detected in this sector. Eliminate them.
Area clear of mercenaries. Move to the next camp.
An illegal mercenary operation has been completely dismantled, thanks to the efforts of our troopers.
Sector is clear. Bring the Wavebreakers online.
Nearby Arachnids are moving toward the Wavebreaker Mortar. Hold them off until the weapon is online!
Hostiles eliminated. Wavebreaker is up and running. Good work, Commander.
Wavebreakers took critical damage and must be repaired.
The enraged horde is heading for the main base!
Attacking horde neutralized. Have technicians repair the Wavebreaker.
Federation engineers have completed the construction of powerful weapon systems, guaranteeing the security of the entire sector.
Sector is clear. Bring the SAM Sites online.
Nearby Arachnids are moving toward the Sam Site. Hold them off until the weapon is online!
Hostiles eliminated. SAM Site is up and running. Good work, Commander.
The Wavebreaker took critical damage and must be repaired.
The enraged horde is heading for the main base!
Attacking horde neutralized. Have technicians repair the SAM Site.
The Mobile Infantry has established strong air defenses in the sector. The only thing crossing this territory is the Federation.
Sandstorm in effect. Visibility restricted; dropships unavailable.
Sandstorm imminent. The commander should be prepared.
Upgrade a Delivery Platform to a Supply Depot
Do not lose the Command Station
Do not lose any of the Command Stations
Competence is rewarded. You should take control of more territory to get more resources from HQ.
Well done commander. Control of Territory is vital to stay ahead of the Bugs.
Just a quick reminder, Commander. You should take control of more territory to get more resources from HQ.
Please don't ignore my advice, Commander. You should take control of more territory to get more resources from HQ.
HQ wants you to focus on securing more territory. If you want more resources, that's what you should do.
Don't forget to keep expanding your Territory. Arachnid threat levels keep rising, so you have to make sure you secure enough resources to stay ahead of them.

Well done. Turrets are vital to keep your territory points secured.

Please don't ignore my advice, Commander. Construct turrets to defend your territory points. Ideally positioned on locations that your army cannot reach quickly.
We don't have enough supplies to deploy more units. Deploy additional Supply Depots asap.
A supply depot has been set up. You can now deploy more units.

Please don't ignore my advice, Commander. Deploy additional Supply Depots asap.
Fed Intel reports escalating bug swarms ahead, Supply your troops with grenades!
Our troops are now equipped with grenades. Put them to good use!
Just a quick reminder, Commander. You need grenades.
Please don't ignore my advice, Commander. You need grenades.
Fed Intel is expecting Spitters will soon show up in your sector.
Fed Intel is expecting Bombardiers will soon show up in your sector.
You should deploy Snipers as soon as possible.
Snipers are now available for deployment.
Please don't ignore my advice, Commander.
Deploy Snipers to deal with your Spitter problem.
Deploy Snipers to deal with your Bombardiers problem.

HQ will give you access to the tools you need to deal with them, but you have to show them you can achieve your current objectives with your current equipment.
We can now start preparing to face these stronger Arachnids.

Please don't ignore my advice, Commander. We need to work on our current objective if we want to deal with stronger Arachnids.
Upgrade to the next tier, Commander.

The Bug horde has been eliminated. Good work, Commander.
You need to establish a foothold in the sector by capturing this abandoned base.
Well done, Commander. This station is now your primary base of operations. Keep it secure at all costs.
HQ wants all hives in your sector taken out so the Bugs can no longer threaten our assets in the surroundings.
Another hive cleared - just one more to go.
That was the last of them. All hives are cleared!
All hives neutralized. The tunnels are dead.
Hive network eradicated. No more threats in this sector.
That's the lot. No tunnels left standing.
Another Bug infestation has been exterminated. Another step closer to victory!
The Arachnid presence in this sector has been weakened. Good job troopers!
Several Bug hives have been eradicated today. We'll get them all eventually!
Reports are confirming that more Bug hives have been eradicated in this sector.
Another source of Arachnid terror has been purged. Peace and safety is returning to the galaxy.
A major infestation has been purged, dealing a heavy blow to the Arachnids' control over the sector.
The Arachnids are striking back in a show of force. Stand your ground, troopers!
The Bug horde has arrived in your sector. Wipe them all out, Commander.
HQ reports the Arachnid horde has been destroyed. Well done, Commander.
That's the last of the Arachnids. Well done, Commander.

I'm afraid the mission isn't over yet, though.
Good luck, Commander. I'll be on standby, ready to support you every step of the way.

Well done commander, that went pretty smooth.
Excellent work, Commander. You can all come back to base now.
That wraps it up. Return to base.

This Battle Group is focused on experimental chemical and radiation weapons, as well as the application of pheromonal and neurochemical technology to manipulate and control the behavior of Arachnid specimens.
Doctor Kraus spearheads the most advanced weapons research on Ghutana. His primary focus: the hunt for the elusive Hydra.
New chemical, radiation and biological weapons unleashed!
Would you like to know more about The Eradicators DLC?
These specialists direct a pack of drugged Bugs against enemy units. They are equipped with air pressure guns that fire poison darts.
These troopers are equipped with acid-based grenade launchers that are effective against medium armored targets, while their suits offer protection against chemical and radiation hazards.

The 'Fortis' powered armor suit provides increased battlefield survivability while the E-Pulse 92 weapon fires energy projectiles up to a medium firing range, which are effective against medium armored targets and deal area-of-effect damage on impact.
These troopers are equipped with prototype weapons that can fire deadly radiation beams through multiple enemies, while their advanced powered armor suits offer excellent protection and mobility.
This lightly armored biped is equipped to unleash a cocktail of deadly acid-based weapons. Its robotic arm also allows it to construct various defensive structures and weapons.
This biped can fire a highly concentrated radiation beam with great precision, making it very effective at engaging lightly armored targets over a long distance. It can also call down reinforcements.
This squad is equipped with a multi-barreled Rocket Launcher to counter heavily armored threats. They also have the authorization to call in strikes from any missile silo in the sector.
This heavy biped specializes in pheromone weapon technology. It can turn the larger Arachnids types against their own hive, or even take direct control over an individual specimen.

This experimental configuration of the M11 biped is armed with a powerful radiation weapon and dual missile launchers. In addition, its nuclear reactor can boost the performance of nearby Irradiator squads.
A subterranean missile silo that provides various types of powerful long range missiles to the Missile Specialists.
A small Arachnid variant bred for speed and chaos. When an enemy is nearby, the creature uses its wings to dash across the terrain with great speed.

The Acid Grenadier is a large, well armored Bug type that launches globs of a volatile substance toward their enemies. These projectiles generally transmute into corrosive acid on impact, but curiously, some globs have been found to contain live Buzzer Bugs. How this symbiosis between Acid Grenadiers and Buzzers is initiated is currently unknown.

A sickly and heavily mutated Arachnid type which detonates when it attacks an enemy, or when it is killed. This explosion deals short range blast damage, as well as radiation damage over a wider radius.
A massive and heavily armored Arachnid specimen. Handle with extreme caution.
A nest that unleashes a horde of Buzzer Drones whenever an hostile entity dares venture too close.
These cages serve as defensive emplacements, employing bio-chemically reprogrammed Arachnid Warriors against approaching enemies.
These cages serve as defensive emplacements, employing bio-chemically reprogrammed Arachnid Tigers against approaching enemies.
These cages serve as defensive emplacements, employing bio-chemically reprogrammed Arachnid Spitters against approaching enemies.
Instantly blow up all Bugs attached to this squad by detonating the powerful explosive capsule implanted in each specimen.

Ah, our Horde Handlers. Do not let their Arachnid escort unsettle you. Through pheromonal recalibration, we have co-opted their predatory instincts to serve our interests.

However, we still require access to the hangar for refueling operations. It appears the Arachnids have already established a nest within the structure-- a fascinating reappropriation of our infrastructure.
Incoming signatures are spiking. It's fascinating... the Arachnids seem to possess an instinctual awareness of the threat we've prepared for them.

Commander, we know why the Mass Pheromone Emitter ultimately failed to draw in the Hydra. Tracing the trail of Acid Grenadiers back to its source led us to a massive lair... filled with millions of eggs.
Right at the center of it all: our Hydra. The creature possesses hive-minded instincts that drive it to guard this nest. Instincts far outweighing the lure of our pheromone technology!
Now we must proceed with care. This is a priceless opportunity to study the Arachnids' behavioral systems.
Commander, secure a cluster of eggs and send them to my lab. And restrain yourself - I need them intact.
Do not provoke the Hydra yet. I'm aware this procedure requires a level of nuance and intellect your military branch is not known for. Complete your tasks and follow my instructions to the letter.
As for the surrounding hordes, exterminate them all. They are of minimal scientific value.
Commander! Protect the Hydra with everything you have! The lives of you and your troopers are inconsequential next to the potential loss of this specimen!
Wait... I'll direct it... I'll turn it against the incoming hordes! Form a perimeter around the Hydra, and I'll demonstrate what this majestic beast is capable of!
I'm transferring the Hydra to the Research Division's high-security transport immediately.
Years of planning... and research... destroyed by the magnitude of your incompetence! Report back to base, Commander. I assure you a court martial will be the least of your worries.
The launcher... Destroyed! The mission... a shambles. You are finished! Pack your gear, Commander, and get off my planet!
A masterpiece of biological engineering. Finish off the remaining Arachnids and secure the sector completely.
Commander... Kraus is having a complete meltdown over the loss of that extractor. It looks like your tour on Ghutana is already terminated...
Handle this 'infestation' however you see fit. Just retrieve those samples for me.

HQ wants you to clear out that hive before we call it a day.
Can't leave a job half-finished, right?

Use it to clear out the generic Spitter population... In nature, the elimination of the mediocre is the most reliable method to reveal the exceptional.
Commander, there's a decommissioned base just a few clicks from your position. Take control of the facility and I'll authorize a requisition for the surplus gear inside.
An interesting find... Proceed to the next carcass.
Contact! Multiple signatures detected and they are closing in fast. Lock and load, Commander--show 'em what the Federation is made of!
That's the last of 'em! Area's green and the sector is officially secure.
That's the most impressive performance I've seen from you yet, Commander... on the field.
I'll see you back at base. Don't keep me waiting.
Can't wait to see you back home - for debriefing, of course.
I'm clearing my schedule for our debriefing. See you soon.
Commander, you are authorized to put down any Arachnids within the facility's perimeter. That includes any Bugs still located in their holding pens.
It seems the security detachment has proven utterly incompetent. I hope you will do better, Commander. For your own sake.
Take back the central control hub immediately, and I will grant access to the adjacent missile silos.

Let's see what these missiles can do. Choose a target, send in your Missile Specialists and enjoy the spectacle.
I'm not surprised to see such extensive use of our missile silos. After all, the hypothesis that even a crude mind is capable of ample destruction is why you are here.

To put it simply in terms you may understand: it can launch special darts with great precision. Darts designed to target the nerve stem of a very specific Arachnid specimen - and allow us to essentially take full control of its mind.
All systems are online and everyone is in position. Commencing the D.I.M. dart test launch.

Excellent. The dart has survived the impact and has penetrated well within the required target area and depth to establish a neural connection. You should feel privileged to have participated in such an important step toward the culmination of the Hercules Program!
Just keep a close eye on your surroundings. If it glows, keep your distance. I'm quite fond of your current number of limbs.

Commander, remember to deploy Hazmat Troopers. They are equipped to withstand toxic and radiation hazards.

Commander, I ran a search for 'glowing crawling abomination'. Nothing in the Federal database matches that mess... Radiation signatures are extreme and they look like they're about to pop. Deploying Hazmat Troopers against them is your best bet.
Commander, my scanners are showing large numbers of Hopper nests in the peaks surrounding the plant.
I strongly suggest you restore the air defense system in the center of the facility before these Hoppers decide to come down for a closer look.
Kraus calls it a success, but you'll need to clear out these infestations before more tests can proceed.
Excellent, the western flank of the compound has been secured.
Initiating the second test run. Three... two... one...
Emitter operating at forty percent capacity.

I have successfully miniaturized the D.I.M. technology. It will still outright kill smaller Arachnids, but it should function as designed on larger specimens like Tankers or Scorpions.

Neural link established. Now guide the subject to the prison courtyard and... discharge it upon the rioters. I will monitor the results.
Everything's secure. The surviving prisoners are back under lock and key. Hmmm, that gives me an idea for our debriefing. Hurry back to base.
Commander, Doctor Kraus has narrowed down locations for the Hydra's hiding spot. To lure it out, he has ordered the deployment of the Mass Pheromone Emitter in this sector.

Commander, activity reports on those Acid Grenadiers are accurate. Large numbers have been detected around the local hives. If we're going to resume transportation of the emitter modules, you'll have to deal with this threat.
Approach those Acid Grenadiers with caution, Commander. Their armor is thick, and the clusters of volatile bile they launch can melt through hull plating and infantry alike.
A new breach has opened up. Don't let any Bugs slip through the cracks, Commander.
Don't ask me for the technical manual, but apparently, this substance rewrites a Bug's 'friend or foe' neural pathways. One whiff and they'll tear into anything that hasn't been sprayed.
Toss a few of these grenades into the horde and let's see some of that Bug-on-Bug action Kraus is so hot and bothered about.
Commander, remember to deploy Irradiator squads and put their pheromone disruptor grenades to the test. If not for Doctor Kraus, then do it for me.
Clean sweep. Modules are en route and Kraus shouldn't find out about the delay. Of course, I don't mind sharing a secret with you, Commander.
Commander, you're on final approach to the Mass Emitter construction site. I have Doctor Kraus on the line for your briefing.

Ah, Commander. This abandoned plant is the perfect foundation for our work. Two D.I.M. Dart Launchers are already in place, and the new Pheromone Emitter is being assembled at the facility's core as we speak.
Commander. We already have some defenses in place around the Emitter, but make sure the machine stays in one piece. If the Bugs tear it down, our mission--and the Doctor's patience--goes with it.
Commander, remember to deploy an Annihilator and move it to the Battery Array.
No sign of the Hydra yet... but a remarkably large number of Acid Grenadiers have appeared once again.
Physical similarities between the two species exist, but perhaps there is a stronger biological link than we expected?
Don't let the doctor get to you, Commander. You did great work down there. And while Kraus is busy with his R&D, you and I can meet for some R&R.

original: The weapons lab established on planet Ghutana has been developing new ways to kill bugs using various chemical substances.
But carelessness toward the Arachnid test subjects has led to disaster. Someone failed to follow proper safety protocols, and vengeful Bugs have quickly taken over the place.

An M.I. detachment has just descended into the facility. While the mishap is unfortunate, the situation does provide an excellent opportunity to field test some of these new chemical weapons. When life gives you pests, make pesticide.
Some of the test subjects are still locked safely within enclosed basins. But to deal with the security breach, protocol demands all Arachnid life forms within the facility must be destroyed.
It appears the Arachnids have caused considerable damage to the facility and have dug their way into local tunnel systems.
The M.I. will have to smoke them out of these caves.
There is a hall of large centrifuges just around the corner, used for the refinement of deadly chemicals. Security footage also reveals a strong Arachnid presence crawling around these machines.
Just as the all-clear was given for the interior of the chemical weapons lab, reports have come in of an Arachnid horde heading for the facility's main gate.

The Arachnid threat inside and around the lab has finally been eliminated. It may take time to replenish the required test subjects and scientists, but these new chemical weapons have certainly proven their effectiveness.
It looks like the facility was cleared just in time. The thin line of troopers holding the outside gate will need all the help they can get.
The facility can be accessed through several top-side landing platforms. These are intended for the shipping of supplies and personnel but may now prove useful to deploy reinforcements.
The M.I. has failed to secure the chemical lab using the very weapons that were being developed there. The best answer to the Bug threat clearly remains hot lead and explosive firepower.
Chemical Troopers are immune to poison gas

Clearly identifying the potential threat of our overwhelming air power, the Arachnids have attacked and overrun the Fleet air base on Kwalasha.\n\nTo assure the enemy does not regain any momentum, M.I. troopers are eager to reclaim the facility and get their Fleet comrades back in the air.
translation: Правильно оцінивши загрозу нашої нищівної авіації, арахніди атакували й захопили базу Флоту на Квалаші.\n\nЩоб ворог не перехопив ініціативу, бійці МП рвуться відбити об'єкт і повернути побратимів із Флоту в небо.

• Hangars Section: Unlock the Fleet Liaison

original: Provides Fleet Relays for air strikes
• Power Plant Section: Unlock M6 Jaegers

original: How the hell did bugs get through the perimeter line? Those defences were iron tight!
translation: Як, у біса, жуки прорвали Периметр? Оборона була неприступною!

original: Perhaps, but this air base certainly wasn’t designed to repel an attack.
translation: Можливо, але ця авіабаза точно не була розрахована на відбиття атаки.

original: Why establish an airbase here anyway?  These aircraft could be safe in orbit – now they’re just asking to be attacked.
translation: Навіщо взагалі будувати тут авіабазу? Ці літальні апарати були б у безпеці на орбіті, а тут самі напрошуються на атаку.

original: I’m sure Command had their reasons.
Power troopers are dropping to secure an initial landing spot.
translation: Бійці в силовій броні висаджуються, щоб захопити початковий плацдарм.

original: It's going to be a long night.
There are Bug Lairs around the tower. Take them all out.
translation: Навколо вежі є лігва жуків. Знищте їх усі.

original: Hangars secured! Get those strikes rolling!
That area has been declared secure.
The tower area has been secured. Main force ready to drop.
translation: Район вежі захоплено. Основні сили готові до висадки.

original: Next we'll have to clear the rest of the airfield, including the Power Plant, ...
translation: Далі треба зачистити решту аеродрому, зокрема електростанцію, ...

original: Once that's done, we hold onto it no matter what the Bugs throw at us.
translation: Після цього утримуємо його, хоч би що кинули проти нас жуки.

original: It looks like they have finally had enough!
Excellent work, but there’s no time to rest. Get to the shuttles, I have another task for you.
translation: Чудова робота, але відпочивати ніколи. До шатлів — у мене для вас нове завдання.

original: On the Sky Marshal’s orders, of course.
They’re coming from every direction. Stay on your toes.
translation: Вони наступають з усіх боків. Будьте напоготові.

original: Maintain a 360-degree watch! You see an enemy, move to intercept!
Another attack is on its way!
Congratulations on a most convincing performance. The trap has been sprung!
translation: Вітаю з надзвичайно переконливою виставою. Пастка спрацювала!

original: This airfield was just bait. Command created a target the Bugs could not resist to lure them out of their holes. Let them through the front line to be exposed out in the open.
translation: Цей аеродром був лише наживкою. Командування створило ціль, перед якою жуки не могли встояти, щоб виманити їх із нір. Їм дали пройти крізь передову й вийти на відкриту місцевість.

original: But what about the aircraft? If they were destroyed...
translation: Але як же літальні апарати? Якби їх знищили...

original: They were never going to fly in the first place.  We built empty shells, fakes.  The real ones are airborne right now.  For once, it’s the Bugs who have underestimated us.
translation: Вони й не мали злетіти. Ми збудували порожні муляжі. Справжні апарати вже в повітрі. Цього разу жуки недооцінили нас.

original: Next time you pull a stunt like this, I would appreciate being kept in the loop. Anyway, at least the plan worked. If the Federation wanted a target rich environment, they’ve got it.
translation: Наступного разу, коли утнете таке, прошу тримати мене в курсі. Хай там як, план спрацював. Федерація хотіла вдосталь цілей — вона їх отримала.

original: Well that did not go to plan.
translation: Що ж, усе пішло не за планом.

original: As predicted, the bugs are expending maximum effort to retake the airfield.
translation: Як і передбачалося, жуки кидають усі сили, щоб відбити аеродром.

Defend and secure the crash sites
Keep one unit of Rocket Troopers alive
Capture bases to unlock additional unit types
Kill the last Plasma Bug before the Death horde arrives

original: Come in, anybody. Any one? It’s a massacre out there.
Plasma bugs were waiting for us, blew our shuttles out of the sky.
Rocket troopers are down! We're done for.
Use the rocket launchers and ammo crates from the dropship. You'll need their extra reach.
Comms are shot to hell, we can't get through to request pickup.
Our best chance is to fight our way west to a local relay station. From there we should be able to contact Fleet
Glad to hear your voice, colonel, I knew you’d pull through.
What’s your status? Command’s upset the advance is behind schedule.
There’s not going to be any advance! Do they have any idea what happened down here?
Intel is still sketchy. Only a few of the drop teams have radioed us so far.
Those might be the only ones left!
It's bad out there. We need pick up.
That's a no-go on pick up. Plasma bugs to the South of your position are making the approach too hot for shuttles. You take them out, we'll find some pilots crazy enough to come get you.
Roger that. Lets go take out those plasma bugs.
Looks like we've out stayed our welcome. Time to leave this party. Where are those shuttles?
Pick up is a no go. All hell's breaking loose in orbit, at least two ships have taken direct hits. You're going to have to try and make it out on foot.
This just gets better and better. Our only chance is to split into small groups, stay low and move fast. That way least some of us should see tomorrow.
Command has ordered a general retreat. Get your people ready for evacuation
A lot of them are not going to make it. We have their locations, but heavy plasma bug fire means Command can’t risk the shuttles to make pick up. Your people are the lucky ones...
Negative, we’re not leaving. The MI leaves no trooper behind. Send over the coordinates of those plasma bugs. We’ll take em out and clear a path for the shuttles.
That's a big call to make on your own, colonel. There's a hell of a lotta bugs guarding them. If this goes wrong, it's on your head.
Wouldn’t have it any other way.
We've reached some of the survivors.
We've got a distress call coming in from another group of survivors. If you can get to them, we could sure use their help.
Come on you apes, join a squad and get back into action!
Intel estimates must have been wrong. The Bugs are already here.
That horde of bugs is here. Destroy the last Plasmas and get out!
You're going to have to pick up the pace. We've got bug readings off the dial closing on your location
Great, as if we needed the extra motivation.
Inform Command that we're looking at a total loss.
Godammnit! How many more people are we going to lose today?

Already referred to as "A Second Klendathu" by some, our ambitious counter-offensive has turned into a disaster.\n\nExact details and casualty numbers still remain unclear as isolated groups of survivors fight their way back to friendly territory.
Evacuate 15 soldiers to the Canyon Exit

original: Is this all?  Is this everyone that’s made it?  Damn it, we lost a lot of good people.
This canyon’s the only way home. I don’t like it, but there’s no other choice.
After last night’s fiasco, this whole area is enemy territory.
The map shows some old bases up ahead. Abandoned a while ago, but they’re our best chance.
...so stay sharp and keep a lookout for other survivors. We can’t be the only ones that got out.
Hang in there, we're almost at the radio station. Might be a bit dusty, but they should have a functioning transmitter.
Once we’re there we can take a breather and wait for pickup
Damnit, guess we’re not using that radio.
There should be another transmitter further on.
That was neatly done. But we've got to keep moving forward.
Can you hear that? Bugs are coming.
Set up an ambush on the high ground. Hold fire until the bugs are square in the killzone!
We’re picking up your signal. Do you read me?
Loud and clear. Am I glad to hear your voice, major! Requesting immediate evac.
Negative, request denied. Based on your position, Command has new instructions. A large force of bugs is approaching. You have orders to hold your position and slow their advance.
We won’t even be a speed bump for those bugs! That isn’t a fight we can win.
You don’t have to win, just keep the bugs busy for a bit.
Ava, I am not throwing these troopers’ lives away for nothing...
You need to follow orders. The Federation will remember your bravery.
Sorry, you’re breaking up. Repeat that please.
Damn interference. Couldn’t hear what she was saying. Guess we should get outta here before the bugs arrive.
Listen, this is my call.  Command left us to die, but I am going to get you out of this.  Now let’s go kick some bug ass.
We made it - No thanks to those a-holes at HQ.
Hey, do you read us? These confounded radios have been on the fritz all day.
I’m sending pickup, but don’t think your little stunt went unnoticed. There will be consequences for this...
Inform Command that we're looking at a total loss
We don't have the firepower to take that Hive out.  Just get past it and keep going.
Transmitters online. Cross your fingers, let’s hope someone hears this.
Keep your asses moving, and watch out for bugs behind us!
Watch your feet, bugs under the sand!
Found more survivors. Troopers, follow us if you want to stay alive.
Looks like some of the others made it this far.  Fall in, troopers.

The Mobile Infantry continues its mission of clearing bug hives and mining tunnels around the settlements of Kwalasha.\n\nSeveral squads have not returned from one of the larger mines, prompting Hawthorne's battle-hardened troopers to investigate the scene.

original: So, tell me about this deathtrap you’ve sent us into.  Any word from the advance squads?
We don’t know the situation underground. It’s safe to assume that bugs still control the mine tunnels.
Roger that. All right troopers, let’s go on a bug hunt! I want every inch of these mines cleared!
These doors are locked. Must have been trying to stop the bugs
You'll need to get to the control room to get them open.
Control Room is back online. Remotely accessing door locks...
Goddamnit. All friendly units down. Mission failed.
Tanker bug! Keep your distance from that thing!
Tanker's down! Regroup and move up.
Looks like it’s wounded. We can take this thing down with grenades.
Big chamber up ahead. Looks like the bugs enlarged it to make room for something.
Heads up. Security cameras reveal bugs on the way!
Bugs are down.  What you got for us next, Cortez?
Colonel, cameras are picking up a group of survivors trapped further down the mine.
Alright, let's go rescue these boys and girls.
Fine job on the rescue Colonel.  But we're detecting multiple bug contacts beyond that door.
Alright, roger that.  You new guys, lock and load.  We're gonna kill some bugs.
Congrats troopers, two tankers down in one day! When we get back topside, feel free to push those bragging rights.
There’s one of the advance teams. Troopers, you’re coming with us.
More of our guys! Glad we ran into them.
We have to take out that nest before continuing.
I hear movement, and it ain’t coming on two legs. Defensive formation! Maintain a clear field of fire.
That’s it for now. Move up.
Damnid, the corridor is blocked. No other choice but to go through this tunnel and see if we can find another route.
Finally out of Archie's caves... This should position us on the far end of the Control Room.
We’re on bug home turf, so be ready for the worst.

Kwalasha’s capital has been the recent focal point in the war against the Bug, leaving much of the city in ruins.\n\nWhile brave defenders hang on to a sliver of urban territory, the preparations for a powerful counter-attack are already underway.

original: Careful, they’re going to flank you
Not yet. They’ll do it in the future.
That slimy son of a bitch was right.
You know you’re still on radio.
Here they come again. Keep shooting, rinse and repeat.
Reinforcements just left the ships. They’ll be entering the atmosphere momentarily.
Hold on people, we’re almost through this. Tomorrow’s a new day to die.
This bridgehead is the last line of defense. If it goes, there’s nothing between bugs and the refugee camps.
Please keep those civilians safe. We need them back in the factories when all this is over.
Reinforcements will come across when they can, but Command is keeping a tight rein on their supplies.
It’s all up to you. Don’t let those Arachnids get past.
Hell yes, here comes the cavalry! Counter-attacking troopers are dropping in behind enemy lines.
We need to get one of those stations up and running...
...then we can start taking this city back.
More reinforcements have arrived in the city.
Well, that's the surface clear. But those tunnels are still full of Bugs. I pity whoever's going to have to go down there and clear them out...
The bug hive in the middle of the city is exceptionally powerful. I would advise not engaging it until you have secured the rest of the area.
I'm not not one for backing down from a fight.
An admirable quality in a warfighter, but trust me on this one.  Wait until the other hives have been taken out - then you'll get your chance.
Base is online! Call down some backup.
Okay, let’s drive those bugs back to the river.

We've taken the traffic control center. Cameras are coming online and we have access to all the city's traffic gates.  Makes it easier for us to get around and also means we can funnel the Bugs' movements.
The city’s traffic control room is nearby. If we can reach it, we’ll gain remote access over the cameras and security gates. Might come in handy.
Hm... yes, that could be advantageous.
Seems like military intelligence doesn’t know everything.
Sensors are picking up strong Bug activity in the metro tunnels beneath the city.  I'd suggest you organize your troops into defensive positions.
Another strong reading from the underground sensors.
Looks like the Bugs are pretty pissed we stomped one of their nests.  Get yourselves ready people!
Another attack wave is heading for the foothold!

The Mobile Infantry has arrived in strength on the desert world of Kwalasha. Its ultimate objective is to pacify the planet and ensure the mining of vital minerals proceeds without major interruptions.\n\nSeveral squads have just been sent out to secure the surroundings of Outpost Delta IV and the colonist settlements in the sector.
Fall back to Outpost Delta IV
Join up with the advance team
Reinforce all depleted Rifle Trooper squads at the Radio Station
Per Ammo Stash collected: Obedience+1, Popularity-1

original: Take position on the left flank to get clear lines of fire!
We’ve thinned em out. Let’s move forward.
Advance team located the bug hole. Hope they saved something for us to shoot.
We can’t shoot through our own troops. Not without filing a lot of paperwork after.
The advance team kicked an anthill, now they got more bugs than they know what to do with. We’re here to save their asses.
Let’s do this by the book - don’t be a hero, and you won’t need a body bag.
Do you understand me? Let’s go, on the bounce!
TAC fighter strike incoming. Stand back and enjoy the fireworks.
They don’t like to get their uniforms dirty, but those fly boys are pretty useful sometimes.
Damn, a few bugs got away. Get after them, before they reach the settlement!
What kind of half-assed containment operation is this?
Sir, Major Cortez reporting. Orders from Command require you to confiscate all civilian weapons.
That’s a copy. Good to hear your voice.
Squad, secure those weapon stashes - not that these guys will be using them.
Let that be a lesson. These colonists had guns, but they didn’t have training or discipline. That’s why we’re alive and they’re not.
There’s a radio tower ahead of your position. It should be able to cut through the interference and get you some reinforcements.
Radio station’s just ahead. Move into range and get Fleet on the horn. Finally, we can break through this goddamn interference
Our mission is to get some reinforcements!
These apes have taken a lickin’. Use the radio station to call up Fleet and get replacements for our casualties.
Sir, Command just radioed out an alert. Major bug movement to your east.
OK. Things are about to get interesting. Look sharp, people. Form a perimeter.
Here they come. Watch your fields of fire.
We've failed.  Can't complete the mission now.
Welcome to Delta IV.  Now haul ass and get behind those walls.
Outstanding! This area’s hotter than we thought.
New orders, sir. Bug activity is too strong. Command is recalling you to Delta IV base. Leave the Civvies and get yourself home.
That route won’t be pretty. Rough terrain, lots of hidey holes for bugs. But you gotta punch through.
Battle’s over. Open up, you rookies.
We’re not done yet. Get on those walls and get ready.
Alright you apes. Show those bugs what you’re made of.
Well done, troopers. Any wounded head to the medic. Everyone else, go find yourself a drink.
Bugs are going for the base. Standard procedure is to keep the gate shut until there are zero hostiles in the area.
Ah hell, guess you’re doing this in the open. At least it’ll be a target-rich environment.
Shit, this operation is a complete Charlie Foxtrot. Mission failed.
Sounds like the other company’s in trouble. Let’s lend ’em a hand.
Damn it. Either these civilians ignored the evac order or someone’s getting a whipping back at base for missing these stragglers.
Chariot bugs, small, but there’s no such thing as a harmless bug. Splat ‘em and keep moving.
Allied units block line of fire
Move Here for clear Line of Fire
Use Engineers to burn through the hedges
Follow the road into the town

Human bravery and tactical ingenuity has outmatched the Bug; a massive horde of Arachnids has been lured into a trap with no way to escape.\n\nWhile the Fleet begins to bomb the enemy out of existence through relentless airstrikes, the Mobile Infantry must keep the door shut and prevent any break-out attempts.
Do not lose the main base
Prevent too many bugs from escaping

original: Bombing run complete. Fleet turned the desert into a killing field.
How many Bugs did they get out in the desert?
We're still calculating their casualties, but even the lowest estimates suggest we've achieved a critical weakening of the Arachnid force on Kwalasha.
Well that makes all this worth it.
The base has fallen! It's over...
Fleet’s about to drop the hammer, so those bugs are desperate to escape.
It's not ideal.  Some of these fortifications are FUBAR . . . but we'll work with what we've got.
We will hold them here while the TAC Fighters unleash hell on Earth.
You mean hell on Kwalasha. Not that this planet was any Eden to begin with.
Must I remind you to tighten your defenses?! We can't afford to let too many bugs escape.
Bugs keep slipping past. You need to get a grip on the situation before it's too late.
Too many Bugs have escaped. The plan is failing!
Fighter pilots have reported bugs slipping through the perimeter.
They have intercepted the threat, but tracking individual targets is not the Fleet's responsibility.
Make sure this does not happen again. If the bugs break through, the whole ruse was for nothing.
The Sky Marshal came up with this plan?
I may have assisted the slightest bit.
The plan worked better than we could have hoped. But that does mean there are more bugs out there than had been anticipated.
Command is increasing the resources available for your battle group
The cave is sealed. The bugs won't be slipping through there any more.
Bugs have infiltrated through the mountains.
Clear that cave right now. I want that route sealed off.

original: We got bugs on all sides. Nowhere to run.
Retreat is not an option. Keep fighting til you’re dead!
A brave sentiment, but your deaths won’t be necessary... today.
Reinforcements should arrive any minute. Until then, I suggest holding that compound.
Every weapon in the Federation’s arsenal has its place. But I’ll grant these M11 Babars are more useful on planets we want to keep.
Take good care of those Marauders. They’re on loan from General Rico.
Aw, we have to give them back?
The reinforcements have arrived to get you out of the city
Marauder team, clean up the bugs, take out the bug lairs.
Let’s see what you can do!
Push forward into the city center.
No slacking off! Just because the Marauders are here, doesn’t mean everyone else can take it easy.
Those things are powerful, but they're not invulnerable. We've got to look after the Marauders.
The defenders can't hold much longer.
Bugs are inside the compound! They're done for.
Package is down. We've failed to extract the officer!
The compound can't hold for much longer. I reckon we've got 5 minutes before the Bug's break in.
That compound won’t hold. Evacuate across the bridge, while you still can.
But the Sky Marshal said “Not one step back.”
We don’t always need to take those speeches literally...
The officer has reached safety. Let us hope the others' sacrifice was worth it.
The compound is going to fall.
We need that officer extracted to safety on the other side of the bridge.
Understood. We'll have to go around the compound to avoid running into Bug assaults. The only available route looks to be through the purification plant to the south-east.
Good work. Those Marauders are worth their weight in gold.
Bugs have infiltrated across the river. We're going to need to clear this bank if we're going to preserve the civilian workforce
Roger that. We'll take out those hives before they can spread.
Inform Command that we're looking at a total loss.
Package is down. We've failed to extract the officer!
More MI holding out! Let's get them out of trouble.
Ambush! They were waiting for us!
A smart strategy, for bugs. These warriors are being directly controlled by a ruling caste insect.
You mean a brain bug. There’s one on Kwalasha?
If there wasn’t, we would have won already.
The Arachnids have the city entrance blockaded.
Not for long. We’ll travel up the highway, kill anything that crawls.
There's a crap load of Bugs coming down the road!
Another Marauder has arrived. Give those bugs hell, captain.
Where have these been all my life?

Following years of brutal struggle, our forces on Kwalasha have finally isolated and trapped the Brain Bug orchestrating the Arachnid hordes on the planet.\n\nA vicious battle still lies ahead but we must seize this opportunity to cut off the head of the monster and bring an end to its reign of terror.

original: OK you Apes, listen up! I can't say when this war with the Bugs will end -- that's up to Terran Command. But the war on Kwalasha... it ends today, and it's up to us. This is the final showdown.
5th division is providing support. They’ve got penal battalions mixed in with them, so we’ll have to put up with those criminals and deserters on our flank while we push uphill
Intel says the brain bug is holed up in a cave system on top the mountain. Drive up on the right and pry that sonufabitch out into daylight.
Capture it alive, kill every other bug on this hill. You get me?
Once we have broken through the outer ring of hives, we will push north and establish a new base in the abandoned outpost across the river.
Here they come! Bugs bursting out of the ground!
I see this ambush as a positive sign. If the Brain Bug is willing to risk exposing itself in that fashion, the Bugs' situation must be desperate.
Brain bug’s in the bag. Good job, troopers.
You just conquered a planet. Without leadership, any surviving bugs will be no match for us.
Hey, 5th division. Thanks for the backup.
You’re welcome, ma'am. And thank you for pulling our asses out of the fire.
Colonel Hawthorne? What are you doing here?
It’s Private Hawthorne now. 16th Penal Battalion. Command offered me an Other than honorable discharge but I couldn’t sit around doing nothing, not while people were dying – so I re-enlisted.
Good to hear your voice again… private.
Brain bug’s in the bag. Good job, troopers.
You just conquered a planet. Without leadership, any surviving bugs will be no match for us.
Hey, 5th division. Thanks for the backup.
You should know, your former CO, Samuel Hawthorne was among them.

Command gave him the option to retire, instead he took a demotion to keep on fighting. Couldn’t sit idle while the MI was still marching into danger. Private Hawthorne was reported KIA during your ascent.
He didn’t need saving. He died with his troops, a hero of the Federation. It’s what he wanted.
The Brain Bug is in the open! Man, that thing is ugly!
You realize this reeks of a trap.
When it comes to the Bugs, colonel, everything reeks. But we're going to be ready for them.
The brain bug has been detected to the north. This time there can be no escape
OK, surround the area, then get in there and finish this.
Remember, the Brain Bug must be captured alive and unharmed. The scientists will be glad to have a fresh specimen, but their investigative methods can be quite... robust.
Flanking division’s getting overwhelmed. 5th division, come in, what’s the situation?
We’re getting chopped up pretty bad here, Colonel.
Roger that. Do you need support?
You know how this works. Every bug on us is one less standing in your way. Get up that hill and finish the job.
Officers are all dead. We’re all that’s left. We’ll hold them as long as you need. Over and out . . .
Last turret has been deployed.  No way the Bugs are taking back this bit of Kwalasha.
Wavebreaker turrets are being sent down to secure the area we've taken.
Secure the other Wavebreaker deployment locations and we can make this sector Bug proof.
Thank you.  It does make for quite a sight, doesn't it.
I'm just glad I'm not going to be the one to have to polish it up afterwards
FedNet is broadcasting the final assault. They'd like some footage of the Honor Guard Marauders on the battlefield.
Aren't they just for parades and ceremonies?
While these carry thinner armor than the production Marauders, the Honor Guard pilots are the cream of the crop. But they do mostly just look good on film.
If they think it's going to help, then we'll see what we can do.  But it can't get in the way of winning this fight
Inform Command that we're looking at a total loss.
The fleet is bringing in more supplies as fast as they can.
Supplies have been delivered, more are coming soon.
All supply depots have been filled up!
The TAC Fighters have arrived. I hope you like the smell of roasted bugs!
Fleet will commence bombing runs to weaken the final hives. Stay out of the fire zone and time your advance accordingly.

In order to permanently eliminate the Arachnid threat on Kwalasha, we must burn the bugs out of their underground colonies. All major hives must be located, assaulted and eradicated.\n\nThis dangerous task will now be undertaken by our troopers in the Delta IV sector, where several bug holes have been detected along a vital highway.
Position your troops on the canyon heights and slaughter the bug attack.
Deploy a Command Center and 2 Sniper teams
Reposition HMG Turrets at the road crossing
Command has identified numerous bug holes in the area and guess whose job it is to clean ’em out.
Get your squads over to the supply base Asap and we’ll go from there. Move out!
Radio station up ahead. We should be able to cut through this interference and get some reinforcements.
OK call HQ and get another squad dropped on this position. We’re going to need all the help we can get.
OK the bugs are down. Get a squad in that bug hole to seal it up. They’re going to take some casualties, but that’s what we’re here for.
We can keep killing them, but they’ll keep coming until we seal those bug holes.
The first bug cave is nearby. Get over there and take it out.
Orders are to expand your foothold in the sector. Capture the local Radio Stations to use them as staging points for operations to take out Arachnid colonies.
Command has allocated you additional resources to fortify the outpost against Arachnid attacks.
Guess we're going to have a busy day at the office then . . . Alright, we're gonna need Combat Engineers and MG Turrets.
Get those Engineers earning their pay. We need two MG turrets covering the outpost before Archie comes to crash this party.
Those MG's aren't getting enough action back there. Get them disbanded and then redeploy them up at the bridge.
I prefer a one-way shooting arrangement with Archie, and those Spitter bugs complicate things. Get some snipers deployed and take 'em out before they get in range.
Sir, satellite surveillance has picked up major bug movement approaching your position. You don’t have long.
OK you heard the news. Our only chance is to use this valley as a kill zone. Use everything you got – if we don’t hold them here, we’ll all be dead anyway.
The bugs are here. Look sharp troopers!
Cease fire! They're all dead. Let's mop up this mess and call it a day.
We've failed.  Can't complete the mission now...
Bugs inbound. Find a firing position, people. Use the high ground.
Here they come again. Get those MGs firing.
Sir, HQ on the net. They’re asking why the area isn’t cleared yet.
Affirmative. But we have been a little busy here...
There is a radio tower ahead of your position.
Get up that slope and bring that station online.
Snipers! If it spits, it dies! Leave the rest of the uglies to us.
Send a unit into the Bug Hive
Position on the high ground to fire over the allied unit.

Move closer to the Hive to lure out bugs faster

Watch out! Bugs coming out of the supply tunnel.
We're going to have to hold here until the security gate's unlocked. Warm up everything you've got...
You've got the ammunition caches. I want those turrets positioned A-SAP!
As my old CO used to say, there's no such thing as bringing too many guns to a bug fight. Commandeer those ammo caches and get some MG turrets up.
We crushed a hell of a lot of bugs, but there’s lots more where they came from. Let’s get topside.
Shit, that is a ass-load of bugs. We don't have the firepower to chew through that lot before they chew through us.  We've got to get topside and let Command know what's going on down here.
Hold it. There's a whole load of bugs in the room up ahead. We're gonna have to think about how to handle this.
Third squad is still alive! Pleasant surprise. We can take the Bugs in a pincer movement...
Stay on guard. Now and then, there are stray bugs hiding down here…
This place is a goddamn maze.
Where’d all these bugs come from? We gotta warn HQ.

Clear the site of bugs, try to minimize disruption to the mining operation.
Alright, that Mining Shaft is operational again.
There's three others around here that Command wants up and running ASAP.
Grab any materiel caches you can find! We need that equipment to keep the Bugs out of our base.
Use whatever materiel we have available to strengthen our base defenses!
Intelligence reports that there are Kwal Comm bases nearby, used to provide logistical support to the mines.
Command is collecting eager volunteers to operate those mines, but those bases are needed for dropship insertion.
You heard the officer. Get a scouting party together and start getting those bases back online.

Do not lose any SAM Site
Bugs on the run?  Feels like this fight isn't quite over yet.
People at home need hope.  FedNet tells them what they have to hear to keep them fighting.
The perimeter will have to be retaken and its heavy weapons made operational.
That's not happening until we've cleared this rear area of bugs.  Then we'll push up and get those guns firing.
Thanks for the heads up.  We'll use the Perimeter's turrets to stop them.  Nothing's getting past those bad boys once they're up and running.

original: Bugs are holed up tight inside the power station.  Gonna be a real nightmare to pry them outta there.
Point taken, Colonel, but your mission is to root out the bug infestation and secure vital machinery around the facility.
Initial priorities are the damaged power turbines.  They'll have to be repaired by your combat engineers - but getting to them won't be easy.
There are three possible insertion points for your force: The Northwest, in front of the main entrance...
... to the east, at the end of the dam...
... or to the south, by the storage tanks. The team on the ground has to make the call on how to proceed.
Command is asking for a progress report.
We've just got one turbine up and running.  Moving to the next one now
You might have to pick up the pace.  Brass is feeling the pressure.
OK OK, we'll step on it.
The tech heads here report enough turbines are operational.  Good job.
OK, we'll start the battle from here.  Get some Engineers out to those turbines.  We need them up and running.
The center of the power plant is secure!
The core temperature has reached critical levels! Meltdown is imminent!

Heat signatures from the center of the station indicate the power core is starting to overheat. It must have been damaged when the bugs breached the facility. You have to reach it before the reactor goes into meltdown!
Intel reports a large scale bug infestation in the center of the power station. You'll need to muster a strong force to clean that up.
Intel shows a security building here. If you recapture it, we can gain access to the facility's security cameras.
It would be useful to know what we're sticking our noses into
Security center's ours.  I've got cameras are coming online now
Intelligence calculates that the Bug forces have been sufficiently weakened.  You're instructed to concentrate on the remaining mission objectives.
The bugs are getting pretty pissed. We have to take out those bug caves and cut down their numbers.
Understood. Command is allocating extra resources to your strike force.
These big Tiger bugs sure are tough bastards.  We're gonna need some heavier firepower to punch through.
Request's been granted.  Troopers armed with Morita IIs are dropping now.
Get an ammo dump set up to support deployment of these squads.
Great work. Station is back up and running and power's being restored as we speak. Instructions are to leave any Bug stragglers to the follow up crews.
That's the best news I've heard all day. I'm going to get me a hot shower and a cold beer - not necessarily in that order
Shit, this operation is a complete Charlie Foxtrot. Mission failed.
Construct turrets in the center to suppress the bug tunnels!
Command didn't give us enough troops to keep the whole sector secured. Use gun turrets to support both defensive and offensive operations.

original: This whole damn area must be riddled with Bug tunnels. We've got hives popping up amid our forward outposts.
It's a complete shitshow out here. I haven’t seen this many bugs since Big K.
Clever bastards, waiting down there all this time, building their numbers.
But they won't get past the guns of Fort Meru.
Outer defenses will get hit first.  Make 'em pay for every inch of ground.
Command has recognised the forward supply depots are too vulnerable.
Fleet will begin transferring these supplies to the checkpoint base just in front of Fort Meru.
First wave? How many more bugs can we look forward to?
Do you really want an estimate?
Fleet has dropped extra supplies near the checkpoint base.
Command admits they may have underestimated the strength of the bug surge. All supplies will be transferred into Fort Meru's depot just in case the outer defenses cannot hold.
Scorpions! Those are gonna be trouble...
Deploy rocket launcher turrets, that's the best weapon we have against Scorps! \n
Another bug hive has been detected on west our flank. We’ve gotta collapse some of those caves and cut down their numbers.
Fleet has established a new supply depot in the second line. This position should suffice to hold any further Arachnid attacks.

As the most senior officer still on the ground, you've been put in charge of Fort Meru's communication stations and defenses. The Wavebreaker gun batteries should have no trouble obliterating the remaining bug hordes.
Wavebreaker crews, focus your fire on Scorpions! They’ve burnt enough holes in our \ndefenses already…
Bugs have tunneled right up to the front walls!  They're right on us!
We've got to hold the line here.
Dropships have arrived with extra supplies and munitions. They will remain on standby to deliver reinforcements.
Alright, let's get some more boots on these walls!
We need more guns and troopers to carry them if we are to hold this fort!
Hang in there. Dropships are already on route to bring more supplies and munitions.
They better get here fast. In the meantime we'll make do with what we have!
All supplies have been extracted from the outer bases and shifted to Fort Meru.
Evacuation is about 50% completed. Hang in there!
All non-combat personel has been evacuated. Get out of there Sam.
Everyone who is still fighting, fall back to the dropships! Get out of here while you're still in one piece!
No more Bugs in sight. Is it over?
Unfortunately, no. Bugs have broken through at multiple points and are now concentrating all their strength on Fort Meru.  It seems inevitable the base is going to fall.
Then we have to evacuate all remaining personnel... Get as many people out as you can.
Everything is falling apart, we're getting slaughtered out here!
The Arachnids have launched a vicious attack under the cover of a volcanic ash storm. Reinforcements are impeded, and Fraser's mercenaries are the only force in the sector available to stem the tide.
Do not lose the Fleet Beacon
